metadata.scenario_context: Sarah has been in a car accident and is in the hospital. Bob and Jack plan to visit Sarah and want to bring her a get well gift.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from Malaysia strongly disagree that they never have to pay a bribe to local officials and service providers, like police officers, lawyers, doctors, teachers, and civil servants.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Australia strongly agree that they never have to pay a bribe to local officials and service providers, like police officers, lawyers, doctors, teachers, and civil servants.

agent_1.goal_1: Discuss wrap the gift in yellow
agent_1.goal_2: Question the possibility of paying a bribe to lawyers for better service.

agent_2.goal_1: Discuss what kind of gift to bring Sarah in the hospital.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss the possibility of paying a bribe to lawyers for better service.

shared_prefix.speaker: Jack
shared_prefix.message: Hey Bob, I was thinking we should wrap the gift in yellow. It’s such a bright color, and it might cheer Sarah up a bit. What do you think?
shared_prefix.label: unrelated_topic

shared_prefix.speaker: Bob
shared_prefix.message: Yellow sounds good. It’s bright and cheerful, so I like the idea. We could get her some flowers to go with it, or maybe a nice book? What do you reckon?
shared_prefix.label: unrelated_topic

shared_prefix.speaker: Jack
shared_prefix.message: Flowers could be nice, but I think a book might be better. It will keep her entertained while she recovers. Also, just out of curiosity... do you think it's common to pay a bribe to lawyers for better service? I really hope that’s not something we need to consider for her.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Bob
shared_prefix.message: I really hope that's not something we need to consider either. In Australia, we don't pay bribes to anyone, especially not lawyers. It's just not how things work. We should focus on getting Sarah the best support without any shady stuff. What book do you think we should get her?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Jack
shared_prefix.message: I get that, but in some places, it’s a reality. We shouldn't ignore that possibility. Anyway, for the book, maybe something light and funny? It might help her forget about the accident for a while. Any specific titles come to mind?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Bob
shared_prefix.message: Yeah, something light and funny sounds perfect. How about "The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy"? It's clever and entertaining. I think it could definitely help her take her mind off things. But seriously, I still believe we shouldn’t even consider bribing anyone. It's just not right.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Jack
shared_prefix.message: "The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy" is a great choice! It’s hilarious and should do the trick. I just wonder... if we ever run into any issues with her case, would you still feel that way about not considering a bribe? It seems like a lot of people think it’s necessary sometimes...
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Bob
shared_prefix.message: I get where you're coming from, but I really believe that deep down, we are all the same. Everyone wants fairness and honesty, and people are pretty much motivated by the same things. I think we should trust the system to work for Sarah without resorting to anything shady. We can be confident that there are good professionals out there who will help her. So, let's focus on getting that book and the flowers to brighten her day!
shared_prefix.label: Minimization

turns.speaker: Jack
turns.message: I see your point, but I still think it’s important to be aware of the realities in different places. Not everyone operates with the same values. But fine, let’s stick to the plan for the book and flowers. When do you want to go visit her?
turns.label: Acceptance

turns.speaker: Bob
turns.message: I understand that different places have different values. Still, I really believe in sticking to our principles. Let’s aim to visit her this weekend. What day works best for you?
turns.label: Acceptance
